question: Birsa Munda Hockey Stadium was built in which state?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Odisha**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Birsa Munda Hockey Stadium** is located in the state of **Odisha**.
 
• This stadium is one of the prominent venues for hockey in India, often hosting national and international matches.
 
• It is named after Birsa Munda
